implementation.rule: Treat the packet as the entire non-default snapshot. Update supplied rows, delete omitted rows for this character, and insert new rows in one SaveChanges call. An empty snapshot clears this character options. Publish an independent replacement cache only after successful persistence.
implementation.preserved: Raw option text including canonical grouped IDs, other characters, and mission progress. No reset value is invented; absence lets the original client load its registered default.
implementation.prior_defect: Empty saves returned without writing; nonempty saves only merged rows, retaining omitted default-valued options. Cache was changed before the database committed.
implementation.duplicate_ids: The last supplied value wins before database staging, avoiding duplicate tracked row objects.
